시편-142-1.title: 시편 142장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-142-1.exegesis: PSALM 141 Psa 141:1-10 . This Psalm evinces its authorship as the preceding, by its structure and the character of its contents. It is a prayer for deliverance from sins to which affliction tempted him, and from the enemies who caused it.

시편-142-2.title: 시편 142장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-142-2.exegesis: PSALM 142 Psa 142:1-7 . Maschil--(See on Psa 32:1 , title). When he was in the cave--either of Adullam ( 1Sa 22:1 ), or En-gedi ( 1Sa 24:3 ). This does not mean that the Psalm was composed in the cave, but that the precarious mode of life, of which his refuge in caves was a striking illustration, occasioned the complaint, which constitutes the first part of the Psalm and furnishes the reason for the prayer with which it concludes, and which, as the prominent characteristic, gives its name. 1. with my voice-- audibly, because earnestly.

시편-142-3.title: 시편 142장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-142-3.exegesis: 2. (Compare Psa 62:8 ). I poured out my complaint-- or, "a sad musing."
시편-142-3.theologicalNote: 2. (Compare Psa 62:8 ). I poured out my complaint-- or, "a sad musing."

시편-142-4.title: 시편 142장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-142-4.exegesis: 3. thou knewest ... path-- The appeal is indicative of conscious innocence; knowest it to be right, and that my affliction is owing to the snares of enemies, and is not deserved (compare Psa 42:4 ; 61:2 ).
시편-142-4.theologicalNote: 3. thou knewest ... path-- The appeal is indicative of conscious innocence; knowest it to be right, and that my affliction is owing to the snares of enemies, and is not deserved (compare Psa 42:4 ; 61:2 ).

시편-142-5.title: 시편 142장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-142-5.exegesis: 4. Utter desolation is meant. right hand-- the place of a protector ( Psa 110:5 ). cared for-- literally, "sought after," to do good.
